I’m happy to share that I’m holding a new position as Project and Marketing Manager at Speed and Function!🚀

In this role, I’ll be leveraging my experience in IT project management and leadership to drive innovation and growth. My responsibilities will include managing marketing activities, developing brand positioning, managing presales and ensuring the successful delivery of projects. 

I’m excited to collaborate with a talented team and contribute to the ongoing success of Speed&Function.

Speed&Function embraces the principles of a Teal organization, where self-management, wholeness, and evolutionary purpose are at the core of our operations. We believe in empowering our team members to take initiative, collaborate authentically, and pursue meaningful work that aligns with our shared values of flexibility, self-discipline, and care. This approach enables us to make a real impact on the world.

A big thank you to everyone who has supported me on this journey. I’m looking forward to the new challenges and opportunities this role will bring.
